gloss: immediately; right away; on the spot

definitions.gloss: immediately; right away; on the spot
definitions.explanation: Describes doing something without any delay or hesitation, responding or acting the moment a situation arises.

examples.japanese: {即座|そくざ}に⟦{答|こた}えた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{即座|そくざ}に⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|くだ}した→下す：12329_kudasu⟧。
examples.english: He made a decision right away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{即座|そくざ}に⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: A problem occurred, but the person in charge dealt with it right away.

notes:
USAGE:
{即座|そくざ}に emphasizes responding or acting without any delay or hesitation. It often appears in contexts where a quick response is notable or praiseworthy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {即座|そくざ}に⟦{答|こた}える→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧ (to answer immediately)
- {即座|そくざ}に⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to respond right away)
- {即座|そくざ}に⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧ (to judge on the spot)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is more casual and versatile. {即座|そくざ}に is more formal and emphasizes the instantaneousness of the response. ⟦{直|ただ}ちに→直ちに：00398_tadachini⟧ is also formal and often used in official announcements or instructions.
